title: Inversion of Object
summary: Invert a JSON-compatible object: each new key is the string form of an original value; its value is the original key when that value occurs once, and an array of all such original keys when several keys share it.
inputFormat: A JSON-compatible object whose values are primitive values (domain not verified).
outputFormat: A new object keyed by String(value).
tieRules: Duplicate original keys for the same value must all be kept in an array; the array order is not stated.
edgeRules: Whether a single occurrence is a bare string or a one-element array is not stated.

examples.label: authored-reference
examples.note: Duplicates only, so the single-occurrence question does not affect it.
